SourceFile
  RootPackage
  struct Empty
  struct References
    field first: String
    field nested: (String, Long)
    field empty: Empty
  fun payload(): References
    =
      Call References
        Binary Add
          StringLiteral "le"
          StringLiteral "ft"
        TupleLiteral
          Binary Add
            StringLiteral "ri"
            StringLiteral "ght"
          IntLiteral 42
        Call Empty
  fun identity(value: References): References
    =
      Var value
  fun main()
    val boxed: Any
      Call identity
        Call payload
    Call gcCollect
    val restored
      Cast References optional=false
        Var boxed
    Call println
      FieldAccess first
        Var restored
    Call println
      FieldAccess _1
        FieldAccess nested
          Var restored
    Call println
      FieldAccess _2
        FieldAccess nested
          Var restored
    Call println
      Binary Eq
        FieldAccess empty
          Var restored
        Call Empty
